segments.text: Now the only Use I shall make of this point shall be that which lyeth directly both in the eye of the Text, and of the design for which it was chosen: namely, by it to try, and examine the truth of our interest, and the validity of our claim to Jesus Christ. In pursuance of which design I shall first lay down some general rules, and then propose some particular tryals.
First, I shall lay down some general rules for the due information of our minds in this point upon which so great a weight hangs.
